_comment: Position V1: a stereo tracker written with OpenCV, plus a fake IMU.
All of these are starting guesses, tuned by tools/check_position.py.

_keyframes: The drone is measured against a keyframe, not against the previous
frame. It moves about 3 cm per frame, and 3 cm of parallax against
a wall 2 m away is mostly noise -- frame-to-frame tracking never
failed and simply stopped accumulating, stalling at 0.9 m while the
drone really travelled 1.8 m. The reference is held until one of
these says there is something real to measure against.

fake_imu._comment: Plausible for a cheap phone-grade chip. Bias is the slow error that never averages away.
